data.narrative:
Duranium is a pre-seed Climate & Energy company founded by Berkley Noble and Brenden Prins-McKinney. The company has raised $2M+ to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector includes 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though none of the private peers share sufficiently similar stage, adjacency, or valuation-tier characteristics to form a narrow peer-median analysis.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method. Using total capital raised of $2M as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of the Pre-Seed to next-stage transition yields an implied valuation of $5M.

The triangulated range is $4M to $6M, with a median of $5M supported by the stage-progression method. Key uncertainties constraining precision include the absence of a sufficiently dense comparable set at the pre-seed stage in Climate & Energy, limiting peer-relative validation. Investors should treat this range as indicative of order of magnitude rather than a precise fair value, pending accumulation of additional founder milestones, technical validation, or market traction that would anchor future fundraising.
